verdict.line: You win this if you force the all-in while Remove Scurvy (W) is down between levels 3 and 10; you lose ground if you let it stall into a poke-and-scale fight where his itemization and global Cannon Barrage (R) catch the 49% overall win rate up to your early lead.

brief.thesis: Aatrox holds the measured lane and solo-kill edge here because his W (Infernal Chains) into E (Umbral Dash) all-in punishes Gangplank before his Parrrley (Q) poke can out-damage sustained melee contact. The catch is Gangplank's W (Remove Scurvy, 18-22s cooldown) cleanses that root and heals him back, so the 3798-game win rate sits near even — the matchup is skewed your way only in the windows when that cleanse is on cooldown.

theirWindow.when: when you approach without E ready
theirWindow.what: He'll poke you with Parrrley (Q, 5s cooldown, 625 range) every time you walk up at neutral range. Don't eat repeated pokes closing the gap — use minion pathing or hold E (Umbral Dash) specifically to skip that window instead of burning it mid-fight.

yourWindow.when: when his Remove Scurvy (W) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Land W (Infernal Chains) to drag him to center, dash in with E, and unload Q swings for the Deathbringer Stance proc. With no cleanse up he has no answer to the root, so this is the trade to commit to, not a poke exchange.

start.why: The flat damage reduction on autos blunts both his Parrrley pokes and the ramping Grog-Soaked Blade poison, which is the only thing that can out-sustain you before level 6.

boots.why: Most of his early damage is auto-attack poke plus Parrrley, so the flat physical reduction outvalues magic resist at this stage of the matchup.

core.why: The burst proc after landing two hits matches the W-into-E all-in pattern and threatens the execute during the windows his cleanse is down.
Rewards the first-hit crit on an engage and gives healing back on takedown, reinforcing the forced-trade game plan instead of a drawn-out poke war.
Converts the physical damage he does land into a delayed tick, letting your E and passive healing outpace his poison and Parrrley chip damage over the fight.

situational.when: the laning phase drags out and you need faster W and E uptime to keep re-forcing all-ins
he plays purely for range and kites with Parrrley instead of trading in melee
his build is pulling ahead and you need the extra survivability to keep initiating safely
his Cannon Barrage slow or late-game poke is swinging fights more than his flat physical damage

runes.keystoneWhy: The adaptive-force ramp rewards staying in extended melee contact through W-E-Q chains, which is exactly the forced-trade pattern this matchup wants, rather than trading pokes at range.

summoners.why: Ignite is the most-run pick and converts your W-into-E all-in into a guaranteed kill once Remove Scurvy is down. Take Teleport instead if the matchup settles into a scaling, split-push oriented lane.

playing.title: Track Remove Scurvy, not his HP
playing.detail: His W is an 18-22 second cooldown reset button. Commit your W (Infernal Chains) all-in specifically when it's down — fighting into it means he cleanses your root and heals off the trade.

playing.title: Close distance on your terms
playing.detail: His Parrrley (Q) is a 5-second-cooldown, 625-range poke that punishes a slow walk-up. Use E (Umbral Dash) to skip the poke window instead of auto-walking into range and eating free pokes.

playing.title: Chain W into Q for sustain
playing.detail: Your Deathbringer Stance passive and E's on-hit heal both need sustained contact. Root with W, dash with E, and land Q swings back to back so the healing outpaces his poison stacking.

playing.title: Time fights around World Ender
playing.detail: R comes online at level 6 on a 120-second cooldown at rank 1. Look to force the fight right as it's available rather than sitting on it passively — the AD, healing, and move speed are what turn an even trade into a kill.

playing.title: Don't fight through full poison stacks
playing.detail: Grog-Soaked Blade's poison ramps with his level and scales off every auto he lands on you. Disengage before it ticks you low instead of trading evenly deep into the DOT.

playing.title: Use brush to kill his poke angle
playing.detail: Breaking line of sight removes his safest way to chip you down from range, forcing him to either walk up into your W range or give up farm to keep poking safely.

playing.title: Bait cooldowns before diving
playing.detail: Don't burn E into a trade where his kit is fully up. Make him use something first, then commit — whiffing your dash into his ready cooldowns is how the early lead gets handed back.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, and summoner spell picks above come directly from OP.GG's measured games on the current patch (16.19.1) — I'm not substituting anything from memory. The tactical reading — when to force the all-in, how to play around Remove Scurvy and Parrrley specifically — is my own analysis layered on top of the live ability data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Gangplank’s Grasp of the Undying – (Q) by hiding inside brushes or maintaining your distance. Be careful of his Powder Keg (E) while using your skills whenever they come off cooldown to deal burst damage.
